Grammys red carpet: Taylor Swift dares to bare, Shania Twain rocks funky suit on music's biggest night
Beyoncé, Taylor Swift, Lizzo, Harry Styles, Bad Bunny, Shania Twain and first lady Jill Biden attended 65th annual Grammy Awards

Ashley McBryde talks Grammys fashion, reveals who she's excited to see perform
Ashley McBryde told Fox News Digital who she's excited to see perform at the 2023 Grammy Awards. She also revealed why she chose her 'very tight' dress.

Grammy night 2023
kicked off with a wild start on the red carpet Sunday at the Crypto.com Arena in downtown Los Angeles.
All eyes were on
Taylor Swift
as she flashed her abs wearing a sparkling royal blue crop top with a matching skirt ahead of music's biggest night.
Swift's Roberto Cavalli two-piece featured a high neckline with sparkling studs dripping down her shoulders and arms. She was dripping in $3 million worth of Lorraine Schwartz jewelry, including 136 carat purple sapphires and kite shaped diamond earrings.
Country music
star Ashley McBryde stepped out in a black strapless gown with a plunging neckline to reveal her arsenal of tattoos.
GRAMMYS 2023: BEYONCE SETS A RECORD, SHANIA TWAIN PRESENTING AND LUKE COMBS TO PERFORM
Taylor Swift stunned wearing a navy blue two-piece set at the Grammy Awards Sunday with Shania Twain.
(Getty Images)
Lizzo, who is nominated for a total of five Grammy awards, kept covered up wearing a bright orange Dolce & Gabbana gown covered in floral appliques.

The
"Truth Hurts" singer
revealed a structured corset bodice underneath with a long skirt to match.
She added a pair of matching sheer fingerless gloves to complete her secretive ensemble.
Sheryl Crow sported a black strapless dress as she walked the red carpet with country sensation Bonnie Raitt.
Shania Twain
went all out for the big night and rocked a glittering Harris Reed suit with a massive black-and-white polka dot print.
Taylor Swift sparkled on the red carpet wearing a bejeweled Roberto Cavalli ensemble.

Mary J. Blige wore a figure-hugging The Blonds dress with a metallic belt and cut-outs along her hips.
Brandi Carlile stayed true to her chic and simple style with a Versace suit and a pop of pink with a silky shirt.
Megan Fox wore a white Zuhair Murad gown with a crystal bodice while Machine Gun Kelly stepped out in a silver Dolce & Gabbana suit.
Camila Cabello stood out from the crowd wearing the PatBO hand-beaded Rosette Gown which featured a sparkling bralette and a thigh-high slit along a black skirt.

Country star Kelsea Ballerini sported an edgy neon yellow dress with a thigh-high slit and a keyhole cut out.
Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson and his wife, Lauren Hashian, shined in his-and-hers metallic ensembles.
Kacey Musgraves rocked a light pink Valentino one-piece with a feathered cape before changing into a red dress to perform the "In Memoriam" segment.
Beyoncé became the most decorated musician in Grammy history on Sunday night with her win for the best Dance/Electronic Music Album for "Renaissance."
The 41-year-old musician now has 32 Grammys to her name.
